guidance.statement: Targeting Rs.80,000 Crores EBITDA for O2C segment in FY27
guidance.quote: Financial performance, strongest ever quarterly performance and like Srikanth said, we are well on the course to do exceedingly well in this year, Rs.80,000 Crores on the O2C basis.

guidance.statement: Retail EBITDA target of doubling in two years maintained; benefits expected from next year
guidance.quote: We are not changing ours that is the target that we are going for. There is no reason, at least as of now, for us to change that target.

guidance.statement: New energy revenues expected from FY2028
guidance.quote: I think we have already given the indication that we will see the revenues for FY2028 from the new energy complex.

demand.statement: Retail registered customer base up 10% YoY to 400 million+; transactions grew 7% YoY
demand.quote: Registered customer base was up 10% on a Y -o-Y basis. It is crossed 400 mil lion. Transactions have grown in line with revenue growth of 7%.

demand.statement: Domestic oil demand strong at 57 million tonnes; gasoline up 8.5% YoY, diesel up 7.5% YoY
demand.quote: Domestic market pretty strong demand, oil demand is at 57 million tonnes and if you look at motor spirit or gasoline, sustained personal mobility and steady automotive sales, this is supporting the cracks of MS, which is up by 8.5% year -on-year, very, very strong growth. Diesel growth is 7.5%

demand.statement: Polymer demand down 3% due to supply constraints; PET demand strong from beverage sector, filament and staple weaker
demand.quote: In terms of domestic demand, polymer demand was down by 3% because primarily supply constrained demand, the availability of material itself was restricted, the imports were completely blocked, and even the domestic supplies were impacted because of the raw material availability.

margin.statement: Retail EBITDA margin at 7.8%, down 10 bps Q-o-Q due to festive shift and online scale-up
margin.quote: EBITDA margin, when you look at it, is 7.8%. EBITDA of Rs. 6,228 Crores. This is before a one-time exceptional charge on account of 7-eleven of Rs.108 Crores

margin.statement: Petrochemicals had fantastic quarter/half-year due to feedstock advantage; ethane-naphtha cracking differential widened to $557 in Q2, up 2.3x YoY
margin.quote: ethane and naphtha cracking differential therefore widened to $557 in Q2, and this was up 2.3 times from a year-on-year basis.

margin.statement: Refining margins supported by diesel cracks up $2.8/bbl sequentially, gasifier uplift, product premiums, and TC fleet mitigating freight impact
margin.quote: if you look at diesel, I think it is almost $2.8 a barrel higher sequentially. So even diesel, which is a large production from a refinery has been quite significant.

order_book.statement: FMCG revenue Rs.8,266 Crores in Q2, 1.6x YoY; H1 revenue Rs.16,900 Crores, 1.8x YoY
order_book.quote: So, in Q2, we delivered a revenue of Rs.8,266 Crores, which is 1.6 times year-on-year growth right now. For the first half, our revenue was Rs.16,900 Crores, again, 1.8 times of the last year's first half.

order_book.statement: Online grocery revenue grew 42% YoY; Ajio Rush orders up 36% YoY
order_book.quote: Online while we are doing with discipline with the right unit economics. If you look at the early shots grocery, online revenue has grown 42% on a Y-o-Y basis.

capex.statement: Data center capex of 44 MW in next 4-6 months; planning another 120 MW plus hyperscaler infrastructure
capex.quote: So, on capex 44 megawatt is something that we are in the process of getting it done, so I think the next four to six months that will be done. Plan wise, we are thinking about another 120-megawatt, but that will take some time and in addition, the one that we are doing for one of the hyperscalers that is more building the infra part.

capex.statement: Investing in dark stores, digital platforms, and supply chain for online business scale-up
capex.quote: We continue to make investments in dark stores and some of our online digital platforms to grow the digital commerce business pretty aggressively.

capex.statement: Commissioned high-speed beverage lines and setting up integrated food and beverage parks
capex.quote: We have commissioned several high-speed beverage lines across states in the H1. We are also working in terms of setting up integrated food and beverage parks across the country right now.

pricing_cost.statement: Naphtha AG-Japan freight surged from $86 in July to $186/tonne in September; quarterly average $122/tonne, 3x YoY
pricing_cost.quote: the absolute numbers are naphtha AG to Japan freight increased from $86 in July to $186 a tonne in September of this year almost like 100% increase during the quarter and our quarterly average number was $122 a tonne, which was like three times higher compared to the same quarter last year.

pricing_cost.statement: O2C margins pressured by SAED levy, high crude premiums, freight, and domestic price under-recovery
pricing_cost.quote: what is dragging the margin down is the SAED levy that is contributed to the negative margins. I already mentioned about the high crude premiums, elevated freight and insurance and there is under recovery

product_mix.statement: Premium electronics strategic for high-value customer acquisition; largest retailer of premium phones
product_mix.quote: We are now the largest retailer in this quarter of premium products, including mobile phones, which is the largest category there from the leading brands like Apple and Samsung.

product_mix.statement: Swinging crude sourcing between East and West of Suez month-to-month in Q2; will continue opportunistic sourcing in Q3
product_mix.quote: I think during the presentation I mentioned that we swung between East of Suez and West of Suez quite dramatically in Q2 itself from month-to-month. So that to be a constant feature we will be looking at all opportunities kind of swing between what gives u s the most opportunistic crude so that we are doing even for the next quarter.

risk.statement: Geopolitical risks: Middle East conflict, Russian refinery attacks, Chinese export quota uncertainty, Houthi attacks on Red Sea refineries
risk.quote: Recovery of the refineries, like the drones are hitting maybe 40% to 50% of the Russian refinery at some point of the time was affected because of these attacks. While some of it is recovering, it is really not fully getting recovered

other.statement: B2B customer base near 4 million (Kirana, HoReCa, institutions); pushing app-based ordering for higher frequency
other.quote: On the B2B side, we have a base of almost 4 million customers. We continue to make investments in dark stores and some of our online digital platforms to grow the digital commerce business pretty aggressively.

other.statement: Solar module capacity 6+ GW now, targeting 20 GW early next year; solar cell nearing 5 GW, targeting 20 GW H1 next year
other.quote: When it comes to the solar value chain, as indicated, I think our module capacity is now six plus gigawatt, and we will be achieving up to 20 gigawatt early next year. Similarly, solar cell is now nearing around 5-gigawatt and we will be achieving again 20-gigawatt capacity sometime first half next year.

guidance.statement: Expects company-wide volume growth of about 10% for FY27 despite Q1 de-growth
guidance.quote: Nevertheless, encouraged by the second quarter's performance, we expect company-wide volume growth of about 10% for FY27, despite the big de-growth during first quarter.

guidance.statement: Expects piping business volume growth of 13% for FY27
guidance.quote: We have given volume growth of 13% in the piping business.

guidance.statement: Expects FY27 revenue between INR13,500 crores to INR14,000 crores and operating margin between 14% to 14.5%
guidance.quote: FY27, we expect our business to grow between INR13,500 crores to INR14,000 crores, operating margin between 14% to 14.5%.

guidance.statement: Reaffirms full-year operating margin guidance of 14% to 14.5%
guidance.quote: We've still given the margin guidance for the full year at 14% to 14.5%. We are very comfortable at 14%, 14.5% we get a very good return on our investment.

demand.statement: October plastic piping volume growth at 23% year-on-year
demand.quote: Up to yesterday, this month, the growth is 23% in plastic pipe system.

demand.statement: Plastic piping volume grew 24% in Q2 FY27, first-half volume growth about 2% year-on-year
demand.quote: In Plastic Piping Systems, volume grew about 24% in the second quarter, bringing first-half volume growth to about 2% year on year.

demand.statement: Industry PVC demand declined 10% in first half per raw material producers
demand.quote: Industry growth, the number what we got from the raw material producer is minus 10%.

margin.statement: Packaging segment margins hit by steep polythene price increases linked to crude and Middle East supply constraints
margin.quote: Elevated prices are difficult to pass on. The increase were too steep in the polythene price, because it is directly linked to crude price, then cheap supply was not able to come from Middle East.

margin.statement: Price increases passed on after 10-15 day lag to help distributors repair balance sheets
margin.quote: We increase the price. We increase the effect in the market after 10 to 15 days.

capex.statement: FY27 capex cash outflow expected at INR700-750 crores
capex.quote: Outflow should not be more than INR700 crores to INR750 crores.

pricing_cost.statement: Announced CPVC price hikes of 3%, 5%, 7% product-to-product effective tomorrow
pricing_cost.quote: Some 3%, 5%, 7% product to product. We are announcing increase in price from tomorrow.

product_mix.statement: Value-added products turnover grew 38% to Rs.1476 crores in Q2 FY27
product_mix.quote: The overall turnover of value -added products increased to Rs. 1476 crores during the current 2 nd quarter as compared to Rs. 1072 crores in the corresponding quarter of previous year, achieving growth of 38

product_mix.statement: O-PVC, windows & doors, bath fittings (MOHO), gas fittings seeing strong growth and acceptance
product_mix.quote: I can say O -PVC business picking up now. We anticipate good growth for the full year in O - PVC. We are introducing several new varieties also in O -PVC going forward in the remaining six months. On window, our business in window is increasing. Every month we are servicing with distributors in the major cities, and we are quite optimistic in the growth of window business. We are also very encoura

risk.statement: Nal Se Jal business not expected to expand significantly this year due to state funding constraints
risk.quote: Nal Se Jal this year as on today, I can say it is going to be much lower than what was the budget. When the state government is not matching fund, the central government will not be money coming. We are not very optimistic of any big volume business in Nal Se Jal this year also.

other.statement: New units at Bihar, Jammu, Erode, Puducherry and Malanpur plus brownfield expansions progressing as planned
other.quote: Work on new units at Bihar, Jammu, Erode, Puducherry and Malanpur, along with brownfield expansion at various sites is progressing as planned.

other.statement: Minimum Import Price on suspension-grade PVC resin and withdrawal of customs duty exemption helped reduce volatility
other.quote: Geopolitical developments in West Asia remain a source of uncertainty, while the Minimum Import Price on suspension-grade PVC resin and withdrawal of the customs duty exemption have helped reduce volatility.

guidance.statement: Management expects capex for the next four to five years not to exceed last year's level, supporting free cash flow growth and future dividends.
guidance.quote: So for the next four or five years I do not see it exceeding what we did in last year. So that way the free cash flows would grow and all the growth trajectory therefore in front of us does not require a signific ant amount of capex than what we spent last year

order_book.statement: Jio added 9.1 million net subscribers in the quarter, taking total customer base to 542.4 million; 5G customer base reached 300 million with 66 million net adds year-on-year.
order_book.quote: 9.1 million user additions for the quarter, industry beating numbers, taking the total base to 542.4 million users and like Pankaj said we added 66 million 5G users, 36 million overall net adds

capex.statement: Peak capex is behind the company; management expects capex for the next four to five years not to exceed last year's level.
capex.quote: peak capex is behind us and for all the growth and opportunity which Pankaj was speaking about, whether it be about these 340 million new users, in mobility or home s, the large part of capex is already done. So for the next four or five years I do not see it exceeding what we did in

fund_raise.statement: IPO proceeds of ₹30,188 crores received; added to cash position making company net debt positive.
fund_raise.quote: You can add ₹30,188 crores of issue proceeds to this to know the actual cash position and plus the business cash flows also.

other.statement: Open to acquisitions if they offer 'one-plus-one-equals-eleven' synergies and leverage Jio's scale and operating capability; not the only way to grow.
other.quote: if we find in a traditional Indian way, one-plus-one-equals-eleven kind of acquisition, then we can evaluate those and then do that because what we see is that we are the only ones that can actually operate at a scale and drive leverage

other.statement: Jio welcomes competition but insists on customer choice; no specific regulatory changes or policy asks mentioned in the transcript.
other.quote: as we said in our statement, is that we always welcome competition, but let the customer choose which one.
